channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Japan protests new U.S. tariff rate, allegation of excess capacity
item.description: The U.S. announced plans to impose a 15% levy on imports from Japan in response to alleged excess manufacturing capacity.

item.title: Wife of Hokkaido Shimbun journalist detained in Russia pleads for his return
item.description: "Please return this precious papa to his little daughter," Nozomi Imai wrote in letters that were handwritten in Japanese, Russian and English.

item.title: Japan may designate secondary capitals in fall 2027, sources say
item.description: The government is expected to start accepting applications from June next year, aiming to launch the secondary capital system in spring 2028.

item.title: Japan to extend tax break for inherited home sales by four years
item.description: The envisaged extension is aimed at boosting the supply of homes amid soaring housing prices while reducing the number of vacant homes.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
